hero.subheadline: An end-to-end platform connecting residents, collectors, and local governments, making waste management smarter, fairer, and more sustainable.

problem.label: Problem We Solve
problem.title: Indonesia's waste management system is broken.
problem.p1: Garbage trucks run half-empty, wasting fuel and time.
problem.p2: Waste collectors don't get fair or transparent payments.
problem.p3: Local governments lack real-time data on waste flows.
problem.p4: Residents still struggle to find a reliable pickup schedule.

how.label: How It Works
how.title: Simple. Fast. Profitable.
how.step1_desc: Residents schedule a waste pickup via the app in seconds.
how.step2_desc: The system optimizes routes and automatically sends the nearest EcoBuddy.
how.step3_desc: Residents earn rewards, collectors receive instant payment, and data flows into the city dashboard.

traction.label: Real Traction
traction.title: Not just an idea. We're already running.

features.label: Platform
features.subtitle: One ecosystem that benefits residents, collectors, and local governments simultaneously.
features.f1_desc: Our smart algorithm optimizes collection routes in real-time, cutting operational costs by up to 40% and ensuring no pickup is missed.
features.f2_desc: Collectors receive payment immediately after every pickup. No waiting, no hidden fees.
features.f4_desc: City governments gain full visibility: daily waste volume, critical hotspots, collector performance, and automated ESG reports, all in one view.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.title: Hear from those who've felt the difference.
testimonials.subtitle: Real voices from early adopters who use WasteGo in their daily workflow.
testimonials.t1_quote: WasteGo's routing system transformed how we work. Operational time is much more efficient, and managed waste volume surged without needing more trucks.
testimonials.t2_quote: This app motivates residents remarkably. The instant incentive system is proven to drastically change behavior towards sorting waste at the source.
testimonials.t3_quote: The analytics dashboard greatly helps our Corporate Sustainability reporting. We finally have solid, real-time end-to-end data.
testimonials.t4_quote: Pickup schedule is always on time. The interface is also elegant, making me feel like I'm not using a traditional waste app.

hero.description: WasteGo started in 2024 as a university project and grew into a mission: fixing Indonesia's waste infrastructure with technology that works for every stakeholder.

direction.title: Vision & Mission
direction.vision_desc: To become Indonesia's leading waste platform that connects communities, collectors, and recyclers in one efficient ecosystem.

mission_items.m1: Educate communities on waste sorting and responsible disposal
mission_items.m2: Enable fair, transparent earnings for waste collectors
mission_items.m3: Provide governments with real-time waste intelligence
mission_items.m4: Accelerate circular economy adoption through data and technology

items.v1_desc: Every tracked kilogram moves us closer to a zero-waste future.
items.v2_desc: Collectors should earn fairly through transparent and timely payments.
items.v3_desc: Cities need real-time intelligence to make better policy decisions.
items.v4_desc: Environmental impact is our north star, not just a dashboard metric.

milestones.m1_event: The idea was born from university waste-management research. Five founders came together.
milestones.m2_event: MVP launched and the first 50 early users onboarded in Surabaya.
milestones.m3_event: Expanded to 3 cities, reached 500+ active users, and launched EcoHive and EcoCentral.
milestones.m4_event: Scaling to 10 cities while preparing the roadmap for carbon-credit tokenization.
